style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent green botanical agri-supply ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white background #FFFFFF, light mist-green #EEF4EF, jade green #4E9377 with deep pine green #2F6B55 for specimen panels, dark green-grey text #303A34 and one warm orange accent #D9822B used sparingly; neutral temperature; bright soft diffused lighting with a front-left key, gentle fill and soft natural contact shadows at 5500K outdoors; modern geometric sans-serif type in one family, reversed to #FFFFFF on green grounds; consistent thin-outline circular icons with 1.5px #4E9377 stroke and circular photo windows filled with the matching soil or plant texture; consistent rounded-rectangle info cards and numbered circles overlapping card top edges; clean product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable upright package scale and 3/4 hero read with every screen composed as one complete balanced layout; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no reproduced packaging artwork, no brand lettering and no fake logos.
noDrift: no reproduced packaging artwork or brand lettering
